1557-3457-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Seeker of Skybreak is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1557-3457-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

4279-5075-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4359-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4591-7688-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4591-7688-8089.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

997-1349-5239.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
997-1349-5239.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or North Pole Patrol

116-7014-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5662-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater.

1636-2034-5803-7243.description:
Cast Manifest Dread by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Manifest Dread.
Resolve the copy of Manifest Dread, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

338-2034-2557-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-2557-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2034-4871-6005-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

3641-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
3641-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1032-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Power of Fire attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

632-2034-3621-4785-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4785-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

222-527-2438-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2034-3372-6006-6633.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-6006-6633.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

678-1545-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-1545-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the creature's toughness
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
678-1545-5670.notes: If the creature has toughness 2 or greater, this combo will net infinite lifegain.

1322-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2292-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
2091-2292-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

457-1409-5921.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1819-4797-5510-5513.notablePrerequisites:
You have a number of copies of Shadowborn Apostle in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
1819-4797-5510-5513.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Shadowborn Apostle from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Shadowborn Apostle in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Shadowborn Apostle as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Cryptkeeper by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Tormod's Cryptkeeper dies, Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Tormod's Cryptkeeper ability, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

1381-3428-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Alseid of Life's Bounty, adding {W}.
When Alseid of Life's Bounty dies, Mortuary and Ashiok's Reaper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Alseid of Life's Bounty on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ashiok's Render trigger, causing you to draw Alseid of Life's Bounty from your library.
Cast Alseid of Life's Bounty by paying {W}.
Repeat.

2577-3967-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-3967-4871.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

1567-3086-3175-4605.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying {1}{W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1419-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Breya's Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
When Breya's Apprentice dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Breya's Apprentice from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Breya's Apprentice enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

215-353-1283-2440.notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of at least three.
215-353-1283-2440.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Aeve by paying {5}.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a token copy of Aeve for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first Aeve spell.
Aeve enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Ooze you control.
Repeat from step 4 for each Aeve spell remaining.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {2}, returning the nontoken Aeve from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

903-2199-4815.notablePrerequisites: Hedron-Field Purists is at least level one.
903-2199-4815.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you won the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
If you lost the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target of an opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses you or a creature you control to be dealt damage, Hedron-Field Purists prevents that damage.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1385-2034-3054-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {2}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve Pitiless Plunderer's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve Zulaport Cutthroat's ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
